spec.title: The Hardware Root of Trust (RoT) & One-Time P... — Register Bit Architecture

steps.caption: Step 1: Initialize IOT_SEC_CR1 with EN bit asserted (0x80).
Step 2: Peripheral asserts RDY & IRQ flags (0xE0) on IOT_SEC_CR1.
Step 3: Enable DMA burst & CRC verification bits (0xF8).
Step 4: Full TX/RX frame committed with ERR=0 verified (0xFE).
